mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN e.field_status = 'FINISH' AND e.field_finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, e.field_create_time, e.field_finish_time) END) / 1000), 0) AS avg_duration_ms FROM sys_process_example e

SELECT e.field_status, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM sys_process_example e
GROUP BY e.field_status ORDER BY total_count DESC, e.field_status ASC

SELECT e.field_model_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM sys_process_example e
GROUP BY e.field_model_name ORDER BY total_count DESC, e.field_model_name ASC

SELECT e.field_template_id, t.field_name AS field_template_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM sys_process_example e LEFT JOIN sys_process_template t ON t.field_id = e.field_template_id
GROUP BY e.field_template_id, t.field_name ORDER BY total_count DESC, e.field_template_id ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_process_example e WHERE e.field_creator_id = #{myUserId} AND e.field_create_time >= #{dayBegin} AND e.field_create_time < #{dayEnd}) AS today_created_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_process_example e WHERE e.field_creator_id = #{myUserId} AND e.field_status IN ('DRAFT', 'PROCESSING', 'RETURN', 'PAUSE')) AS my_processing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_process_example_workitem w WHERE w.field_handler_id = #{myUserId} AND w.field_status = 'PROCESSING') AS pending_approve_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_process_example_workitem w WHERE w.field_handler_id = #{myUserId} AND w.field_status = 'FINISH' AND w.field_finish_time >= #{dayBegin} AND w.field_finish_time < #{dayEnd}) AS today_approved_count, (SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, e.field_create_time, e.field_finish_time)) / 1000), 0) FROM sys_process_example e WHERE e.field_status = 'FINISH' AND e.field_finish_time IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_process_example_workitem w WHERE w.field_example_id = e.field_id AND w.field_handler_id = #{myUserId})) AS avg_duration_ms
